authority.decision: Use the finite serial family order, let the owner agent freeze the complete contract, and escalate only after all four classes are validly exhausted.

correction.preservedEvidence: The post-843e899 private-state v1 files and remote d486289 remain immutable evidence.
correction.invalidatedInference: The v1 runner verified six pre-labelled carrier records. It did not enumerate causal producer-to-consumer topologies, so carrier exhaustion does not establish family exhaustion and cannot activate the human-authority clause.
correction.trackerConsequence: The needs-info state is not supported unless a corrected finite causal enumeration also exhausts the fourth class.

closedFamilyBoundary.rule: Every valid published family disposition remains immutable. No relabelling, subset, payoff, cohort, policy or method rescue is allowed.
mustRemainClosed: existing Ember reserve damage, Ward and post-combat heal

currentQuestion: Can one currently discarded, deterministic Dusk-only source residual and one existing-policy consumer freeze a complete private-state contract that is materially distinct from all immutable closures?

finiteDesignDomain.producerRule: Enumerate exact current-main bounded transitions whose attempted value is discarded, then retain only a Dusk-specific residual that is not current gameplay state and is not a closed family.
finiteDesignDomain.selectedProducerHypothesis: A positive gain_embers call truncated by ember_cap exposes lost = requested positive gain - realised delta. Retain at most one lost Ember as a non-stacking player-private mark.
finiteDesignDomain.consumerRule: Enumerate normal-pool, reward-only, single-target Attack cards with exactly one ordinary damage effect, no chip, special, status, exhaust or starter identity.
finiteDesignDomain.selectionRule: Prefer a single hit event over multi-hit effects for stronger direct attribution; apply the owner comment's remaining lexicographic fields and canonical SHA-256 only after that comparison.
finiteDesignDomain.payoffRule: Consume one mark on a later same-turn Heavy Blow for exactly three incremental damage, the exact current Flare damage-per-Ember rate on one target. Base and upgraded Heavy Blow remain otherwise unchanged.
finiteDesignDomain.expiryRule: Expire unused state at player turn end or combat end; do not carry across turns.

decisionRule.success: Exactly one complete twelve-field contract passes source, closure, exact-null, lifecycle, natural-cost, telemetry and existing-policy gates under the frozen lexicographic objective.
decisionRule.futility: No complete contract passes; preserve the corrected zero-row evidence and only then reconsider whether all four classes are exhausted.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Two legal contracts remain tied or exact source/closure identity cannot decide at the preregistered zero-row cap.

nextAction: Run one deterministic zero-row design audit over the frozen residual and consumer domains. If it selects exactly one contract, preregister and prove exact-null and direct causal identity before any capacity row.
